family.description: This entry represents a domain found in E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase LIN, a putative E3 ubiquitin ligase involved in the rhizobial infection process [[cite:PUB00156036]]. It plays an important role in the early steps of bacterial symbiont thread formation in roots, and in growth, differentiation and maintenance of nodules [[cite:PUB00156036],[cite:PUB00156035]]. This domain may adopt an ARM-repeat fold.
family.name: Putative E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase LIN, ARM-like domain
